experiments.name: Overnight iron fly ±800, 15:20 → next day 09:30
experiments.hypothesis: Selling the ATM straddle overnight earns the overnight variance premium; ±800 wings cap risk at ≈₹35–45k for less overnight drag than ±400.
experiments.mechanism: Muravyev & Ni (2020, JFE): delta-hedged option returns are negative overnight. Jones & Shemesh (2018, JF): option prices don't fully reflect non-trading periods (weekends favour sellers). E0009/E0010 showed the predicted signs in H1 2026 (short straddle +₹29k gross before slippage, long overnight straddle −₹29k).
experiments.novelty: E0009 with wider (cheaper) wings and a 09:30 exit after the opening print settles; first test on the pooled two-regime window. Spec from critic CRIT-1 (X2), fixed before running.
experiments.failure_modes: Reject if pooled net ≤ 0, halves disagree, or the short-straddle component is ≤ 0 gross before slippage (mechanism falsified). Weekday vs weekend split is a secondary readout only. Expected per-trade sd ≈ ₹3–5k; with ~200 nights the minimum detectable mean at t = 2 is ≈ ₹500–700/night.

experiments.name: Expiry-day iron fly ±300, 09:45 → 15:15, no stop
experiments.hypothesis: On expiry day the ATM straddle's last-day decay plus the retail lottery premium exceed realised moves after 09:45.
experiments.mechanism: Last-day theta; retail demand for cheap 0DTE lottery tickets (SEBI F&O studies 2023/2024: ~9 in 10 individual traders lose; Boyer & Vorkink 2014 JF on options as lotteries; Coval & Shumway 2001 JF on negative straddle returns). Critic screen: expiry-day 09:20 short straddle +31.5 pts/day gross in H2 2025.
experiments.novelty: E0004 without the 50% combined stop (10 of 26 stops cost −₹45k in H1 2026; the stop is suspected of firing on single-leg wicks). Single pre-registered twin (critic X1).
experiments.failure_modes: Reject if pooled net ≤ 0 or halves disagree. Low power: ~43 expiry days; per-trade sd ≈ ₹4.5k → detectable mean at t = 2 ≈ ₹1.4k/day; anything less is 'inconclusive' at best.
